jobs.title: Legal Counsel (Commercial Contracts and Regulatory)
jobs.description: Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were. About the role LemFi's Legal team is small, senior and hands-on. We draft, negotiate and advise ourselves, and we bring in outside counsel only where local law or deal complexity demands it. This role sits inside that team, reporting to the Deputy GC, and owns the contracts that keep our payment infrastructure running: card acquiring, payment processing, banking and payout partners, and the technology and outsourcing agreements behind them. You will work closely with Payments, Partnerships, Product, Compliance and Finance across our regulated entities in the UK, Ireland and Norway. The regulatory advice you give will shape the contracts you negotiate, and the contracts you negotiate will directly affect how fast LemFi can move with new partners and products. What you'll build and own Draft, review and negotiate payment processing, card acquiring, PSP, banking, safeguarding, payout and aggregator agreements, end to end. Handle technology, SaaS and outsourcing contracts, including the ICT requirements under DORA and outsourcing rules for regulated firms. Run the day-to-day contract flow through Jira and SpotDraft: NDAs, DPAs, amendments, renewals and terminations, turned around quickly. Apply and develop the LemFi contracting playbook, templates and fallback positions so the business can move faster on repeat deal types. jobs.title: Senior Privacy Counsel (m/f/d)
jobs.description: Deep Blue Recruitment is working with an international technology company looking to appoint an experienced Senior Privacy Counsel to join its legal team. Operating in the enterprise technology sector, the business develops software and digital solutions for customers across a range of industries. With continued investment in emerging technologies, including AI, data protection is becoming an increasingly important consideration in how the business develops its products, manages risk and works with customers. We're looking for a commercially minded privacy lawyer who enjoys working closely with the business, understanding how technology works and finding practical solutions to complex legal questions. This is a broad, hands-on role combining privacy advisory work, commercial support and the continued development of internal data protection processes. What You'll Be Doing Advise colleagues across the business on a broad range of privacy and data protection matters, providing clear, commercially focused legal guidance. Work closely with product, technology and commercial teams on the development of new services, ensuring privacy considerations are addressed early in the process. Support the negotiation of commercial agreements, particularly around data processing, international transfers, customer relationships and third-party arrangements. Advise on GDPR and other applicable international data protection regulations, helping the business understand and manage its obligations across different markets. Provide legal guidance on emerging technologies, including AI, and the implications of new products and data processing activities from a privacy perspective. Review and improve existing privacy policies, internal procedures and governance frameworks to ensure they remain practical and fit for purpose. jobs.description: PT Bank Mandiri (Persero) Tbk adalah sebuah badan usaha milik negara Indonesia yang menyediakan berbagai macam jasa keuangan. Bank yang berkantor pusat di Jakarta ini adalah salah satu bank terbesar di Indonesia dalam hal jumlah aset, pinjaman, dan simpanannya. Bank Mandiri didirikan pada 2 Oktober 1998, sebagai bagian dari program restrukturisasi perbankan yang dilaksanakan oleh pemerintah Indonesia. Pada bulan Juli 1999, empat bank pemerintah yaitu Bank Bumi Daya, Bank Dagang Negara, Bank Ekspor Impor Indonesia dan Bank Pembangunan Indonesia dilebur menjadi Bank Mandiri, dimana masing-masing bank tersebut memiliki peran yang tak terpisahkan dalam pembangunan perekonomian Indonesia. Sampai dengan hari ini, Bank Mandiri meneruskan tradisi selama lebih dari 140 tahun memberikan kontribusi dalam dunia perbankan dan perekonomian Indonesia.
